idea-plugin.name: Tandem
idea-plugin.description:
A fast, native chat inside JetBrains IDEs that works with Claude Code.
Uses your own installed claude CLI and the sign-in it already has, subscription or API key; nothing to configure, and Tandem never reads your credentials. No webview, no Node, no bundled SDK: new models and commands work the day the CLI ships them. Sessions in a sidebar (ones started in a terminal show up too), model, effort and permission-mode pickers, permission cards, an MCP panel, a slash-command palette and ! command. Claude's edits go through the IDE: each one opens in the native diff viewer (unless you choose to accept edits automatically), where you can change the proposal before accepting it, and lands through the editor, so undo and unsaved buffers work. Claude is told what the file now says. @ in the prompt picks a file, and the editor's selection can go with the prompt.

在 JetBrains IDE 中使用 Claude Code 的原生聊天；使用你已安装的 claude CLI，沿用它已有的登录或接口配置。每处编辑在写入前都会在 IDE 的 diff 中打开。
JetBrains IDE で Claude Code を使うためのネイティブなチャット。インストール済みの claude CLI を、設定済みのサインインやエンドポイントのまま使います。すべての編集は、書き込まれる前に IDE の差分ビューで開きます。
JetBrains IDE 안에서 Claude Code를 쓰는 네이티브 채팅. 설치된 claude CLI를 이미 설정된 로그인이나 엔드포인트 그대로 사용합니다. 모든 편집은 기록되기 전에 IDE의 diff에서 열립니다.
